title: Categorical Exemption from the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Sections 15301, 15301(c), and 15303(e)…
text:
[Council File 26-1535]
Categorical Exemption from the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Sections 15301, 15301(c), and 15303(e) of the California CEQA Guidelines, and Article III, Section 1, Classes 1(3), 1(14), and 11(6) of the City CEQA Guidelines; Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report and Resolution relative to an amendment to License Agreement No. P-58934 and a Grant of Right for the development of and access to a Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) West Valley District Yard parking lot adjacent to the Northridge Recreation Center; and, a City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to an easement for a driveway allowing the LADWP vehicular access across park property.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Amends a license agreement and grant of right letting LADWP develop and access a parking lot beside Northridge Recreation Center, and adds an ordinance granting LADWP a driveway easement across park property.

LADWP West Valley District Yard, Los Angeles, CA
